diagnosis: Checks C1 and C2 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF1. The model is defaulting to high-safety/high-rigor decisions (enabling idempotency enforcement and requiring replay tests) as a generic best practice for any incident response, making these checks solvable without the hidden information.

C2.why: The recorded configuration cause alone does not require timeout-path idempotency enforcement, a duplicate-delivery replay test, or an idempotency-remediation commitment; PF1 changes those choices to require all three.
